candidates.title: Prepare daily multi-service order summaries

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare daily summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.

ease.reason: A beginner can summarize synthetic order records; the post names the output but no implementation reference supports automation.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: operators of multi-service apps might pay for reporting help; the idea post establishes no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can summarize sample completed, canceled and pending records; real data access and accuracy remain open.

autonomy.reason: A proposed batch could draft a daily summary, but source evidence does not establish a running loop or review controls.

evidence.reason: The post names daily reports and three order states, but gives no field details, examples or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Proposed experiment: operator supplies fictional completed, canceled and pending order rows; a manually started daily batch drafts a short summary, checks counts against the rows, and leaves a person to review it. No supplied implementation reference supports automation, so the honest ratings remain below threshold.
